message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to press an attack on the sole active opponent by descending onto a westward intercept, firing its remaining missile as range closes, then continuing behind it rather than disengaging; the missile’s path remains directed toward B0100’s vicinity.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the nearby B0100 missile by sustaining a fast, nearly level left turn from northeast toward north, keeping the missile astern and preventing clear closure as it mirrors this curving path at nearly the same altitude."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to press an attack on the sole active opponent by descending onto a westward intercept, firing its remaining missile as range closes, then continuing behind it rather than disengaging; the missile’s path remains directed toward B0100’s vicinity.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the nearby B0100 missile by sustaining a fast, nearly level left turn from northeast toward north, keeping the missile astern and preventing clear closure as it mirrors this curving path at nearly the same altitude.
